info.name: Emarsys Core API - Contact lists endpoint batch

items.docs: Returns a list of the available contact lists.
Creates or updates a contact list with the provided parameters.

Deletes a contact list.

**Note:** Contacts in the list are not affected.

**Warning:** If a contact list is used in a combined segment, you cannot delete it (error  ``400``, reply ``3008``).

info.name: Add Contacts to a Contact List

items.docs: Adds new contacts to an existing contact list.

info.name: Count Contacts in a Contact List

items.docs: Returns the number of contacts in a contact list.

info.name: List Contacts in a Contact List

params.name: offset
params.description: Specifies an offset for pagination. The offset of the first record is *0*.

params.name: limit
params.description: Specifies the maximum number of records to return.

Returns a list of contacts and their identifiers (`id`) in a contact list.

**Example**

https://api.emarsys.net/api/v2/contactlist/123456789/contacts/?limit=100000&offset=0

info.name: Fetch Contacts in a Contact List

params.name: $top
params.description: Number of contact ids to be batched together in the response.

params.name: $skiptoken
params.description: A token which specifies the position of the page to be fetched.

items.docs:
Returns a list of contact identifiers (`contactIds`) from the contact list.

**Example**

https://api.emarsys.net/api/v2/contactlist/123456789/contactIds?$skiptoken=330&$top=10000

info.name: Get Contact Data in a Contact List

params.name: fields
params.description:
Specifies the fields by identifier or name to include in the returned result.

Multiple fields must be separated by a comma. For example `1,2,3` or `email,first_name`.

params.name: limit
params.description: Specifies the maximum number of records to return.

params.name: offset
params.description: Specifies an offset for pagination. The offset of the first record is *0*.

info.name: Remove Contacts from a Contact List

items.docs:
Removes contacts from an existing contact list.

**Note:** At most 10,000 contacts can be deleted by each request.
